name: XLU & XLRE Rate Beta Analysis
description: Estimates the sensitivity (rate beta) of XLU and XLRE daily returns to daily changes in the 10-year Treasury yield (DGS10). Shows full-period beta via expanding OLS, rolling 63-day beta over time, and a scatter plot of returns vs yield changes with regression line for each ETF.
source:
# =============================================================================
# XLU & XLRE RATE BETA ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
# Question: How sensitive are Utilities (XLU) and Real Estate (XLRE) daily
#   returns to daily changes in the 10-year Treasury yield?
#
# Methodology:
#   Rate Beta (β) = Cov(ETF return, Δyield) / Var(Δyield)
#   — Full-period: expanding window (all available history)
#   — Rolling: 63-day window (1 quarter)
#
# Outputs:
#   1. Summary table  — full-period beta, rolling beta (current), correlation
#   2. cs_lines       — rolling 63-day rate beta over time (both ETFs)
#   3. xy_scatter     — daily returns vs yield changes + OLS trend line (per ETF)
#
# Data:
#   - market_data_source() → ETF close prices (per-asset context)
#   - economic_indicators(series_id='DGS10') → 10Y yield (shared context, daily FRED)
# =============================================================================

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# 10-Year Treasury yield (daily FRED series DGS10, shared context)
# ffill to carry forward over weekends/holidays where FRED has no observation
y10_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DGS10')()
y10 = ffill(y10_raw.result)

# --- Returns & Yield Changes ---
# ETF daily simple return (decimal, e.g. 0.01 = +1%)
etf_ret = returns(period=1)(close)

# Daily change in 10Y yield (percentage points, e.g. 0.05 = +5bps)
# Using lag operator: today's yield minus yesterday's yield
dy10 = y10 - (y10 >> 1)

# --- Full-Period (Expanding) Rate Beta ---
# β = Cov(etf_ret, dy10) / Var(dy10)
# Expanding window = all available history, adapts as data grows
cov_expanding = rolling_cov(window=20, window_type=WindowType.expanding)(etf_ret, dy10)
var_expanding  = rolling_cov(window=20, window_type=WindowType.expanding)(dy10, dy10)
beta_expanding = cov_expanding / var_expanding

# --- Rolling 63-Day Rate Beta (1 Quarter) ---
# Captures how the rate sensitivity shifts across market regimes
cov_63 = rolling_cov(window=63)(etf_ret, dy10)
var_63  = rolling_cov(window=63)(dy10, dy10)
beta_63 = cov_63 / var_63

# --- Rolling 63-Day Correlation (for summary table) ---
corr_63 = rolling_corr(window=63)(etf_ret, dy10)

# Timestamp index for line charts
bar_ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Table — Full-Period Beta, Current Rolling Beta, Correlation
# =============================================================================
# cs_summary_table: one row per asset, columns = metrics
# agg=Last → takes the most recent value of each expanding/rolling series
cs_summary_table(
    title='Rate Sensitivity Summary (Full Period vs Rolling 63-Day)',
    category='Rate Beta Analysis',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    order=0
)(beta_expanding, beta_63, corr_63)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Rolling 63-Day Rate Beta Over Time
# =============================================================================
# cs_lines: one line per asset on a shared time axis
# Shows how rate sensitivity has evolved — regime shifts visible here
cs_lines(
    title='Has Rate Sensitivity Changed Over Time? (Rolling 63-Day Beta)',
    category='Rate Beta Analysis',
    y_axis_label='Rate Beta (return per 1pp yield change)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Gray],
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(bar_ts, beta_63)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Scatter — Daily Returns vs Yield Changes (per ETF, with trend line)
# =============================================================================
# xy_scatter: one chart per asset, x = Δyield, y = ETF return
# show_trend_line=True draws the OLS best-fit line (slope = full-period beta)
xy_scatter(
    title='Do Rising Yields Hurt This ETF? (Daily Returns vs Yield Changes)',
    category='Rate Beta Analysis',
    x_axis_label='Daily Change in 10Y Yield (pp)',
    y_axis_label='ETF Daily Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    x_axis_dp=3,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='Daily Obs', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ]),
    show_trend_line=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero Return', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero Yield Chg', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, vertical=True)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x=dy10, y_values=etf_ret)
